description: This PHP source file defines the 'AOS_ProductsDashlet' class, which extends the DashletGeneric class to implement a custom dashboard widget (dashlet) for 'AOS_Products' within SuiteCRM. It includes initialization of dashlet data, setting up display titles, search fields, columns, and linking to the 'AOS_Products' bean.

classes.name: AOS_ProductsDashlet
classes.description: A class extending DashletGeneric to implement a custom dashlet for displaying 'AOS_Products' data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the dashlet, loads configuration, sets default title if not provided, assigns search fields and columns, and initializes the seed bean.
